BiblicalUsage: eukairía means opportunity. In Matthew 26:16, the text says "And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him."
TheologicalSignificance: In eukairía I find no hidden theology; it simply means opportunity.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus
